signature: SUBROUTINE DLARSCL2 ( M, N, D, X, LDX )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of D and X. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of X. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: d
params.reference: Diagonal matrix D, stored as a vector of length M.

params.name: X
params.reference: On entry, the matrix X to be scaled by D. On exit, the scaled matrix.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix X. $\mathrm{LDX} \ge M$.
